entries.title: I Kings 15:1
segments: ¶Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, Abijam became king over Judah.

entries.title: I Kings 15:2
segments: For three years he was king in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom.

entries.title: I Kings 15:3
segments: And he did the same sins which his father had done before him: his heart was not completely true to the Lord his God, like the heart of David his father.

entries.title: I Kings 15:4
segments: But because of David, the Lord gave him a light in Jerusalem, making his sons king after him, so that Jerusalem might be safe;

entries.title: I Kings 15:5
segments: Because David did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, and never in all his life went against his orders, but only in the question of Uriah the Hittite.

entries.title: I Kings 15:7
segments: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

entries.title: I Kings 15:8
segments: Then Abijam went to rest with his fathers, and they put him into the earth in the town of David: and Asa his son became king in his place.

entries.title: I Kings 15:9
segments: ¶In the twentieth year that Jeroboam was king of Israel, Asa became king over Judah.

entries.title: I Kings 15:10
segments: And he was king for forty-one years in Jerusalem; his mother's name was Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom.

entries.title: I Kings 15:11
segments: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, as David his father did.

entries.title: I Kings 15:12
segments: Those used for sex purposes in the worship of the gods he sent out of the country, and he took away all the images which his fathers had made.

entries.title: I Kings 15:13
segments: And he would not let Maacah his mother be queen, because she had made a disgusting image for Asherah; and Asa had the image cut down and burned by the stream Kidron.

entries.title: I Kings 15:14
segments: The high places, however, were not taken away: but still the heart of Asa was true to the Lord all his life.

entries.title: I Kings 15:15
segments: He took into the house of the Lord all the things which his father had made holy, and those which he himself had made holy, silver and gold and vessels.

entries.title: I Kings 15:16
segments: Now there was war between Asa and Baasha, king of Israel, all their days.

entries.title: I Kings 15:17
segments: And Baasha, king of Israel, went up against Judah, building Ramah, so that no one was able to go out or in to Asa, king of Judah.

entries.title: I Kings 15:18
segments: Then Asa took all the silver and gold which was still stored in the Lord's house, and in the king's house, and sent them, in the care of his servants, to Ben-hadad, son of Tabrimmon, son of Rezon, king of Aram, at Damascus, saying,

entries.title: I Kings 15:19
segments: Let there be an agreement between me and you as there was between my father and your father: see, I have sent you an offering of silver and gold; go and put an end to your agreement with Baasha, king of Israel, so that he may give up attacking me.

entries.title: I Kings 15:20
segments: So Ben-hadad did as King Asa said, and sent the captains of his armies against the towns of Israel, attacking Ijon and Dan and Abel-beth-maacah, and all Chinneroth as far as all the land of Naphtali.

entries.title: I Kings 15:21
segments: And Baasha, hearing of it, put a stop to the building of Ramah, and was living in Tirzah.

entries.title: I Kings 15:22
segments: Then King Asa got all Judah together, making every man come; and they took away the stones and the wood with which Baasha was building Ramah, and King Asa made use of them for building Geba in the land of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

entries.title: I Kings 15:23
segments: Now the rest of the acts of Asa, and his power, and all he did, and the towns of which he was the builder, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah? But when he was old he had a disease of the feet.

entries.title: I Kings 15:24
segments: So Asa went to rest with his fathers and was put into the earth in the town of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son became king in his place.

entries.title: I Kings 15:25
segments: ¶Nadab, the son of Jeroboam, became king over Israel in the second year that Asa was king of Judah; and he was king of Israel for two years.

entries.title: I Kings 15:26
segments: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, copying the evil ways of his father, and the sin which he did and made Israel do.

entries.title: I Kings 15:27
segments: And Baasha, the son of Ahijah, of the family of Issachar, made a secret design against him, attacking him at Gibbethon, a town of the Philistines; for Nadab and the armies of Israel were making war on Gibbethon.

entries.title: I Kings 15:28
segments: In the third year of the rule of Asa, king of Judah, Baasha put him to death, and became king in his place.

entries.title: I Kings 15:29
segments: And straight away when he became king, he sent destruction on all the offspring of Jeroboam; there was not one living person of all the family of Jeroboam whom he did not put to death, so the word of the Lord, which he said by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite, came about;

entries.title: I Kings 15:30
segments: Because of the sins which Jeroboam did and made Israel do, moving the Lord, the God of Israel, to wrath.

entries.title: I Kings 15:31
segments: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?

entries.title: I Kings 15:32
segments: And there was war between Asa and Baasha, king of Israel, all their days.

entries.title: I Kings 15:33
segments: In the third year of the rule of Asa, king of Judah, Baasha, the son of Ahijah, became king over all Israel in Tirzah, and was king for twenty-four years.

entries.title: I Kings 15:34
segments: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, copying the evil ways of Jeroboam and the sin which he made Israel do.
